data.title: 埃塔 · 自体愉悦反应实验
data.description: 《实验记录·第玖拾柒号：自体愉悦反应测定》。埃塔赤裸着躺在实验台上，白大褂垫在身下，双腿在无影灯下分开，指尖有条不紊地碾磨着自己，另一只手还举着秒表。她盯着天花板面无表情地读数：「心率一百三十二……分泌量，超出预期……结论——」笔尖顿了顿，「……暗影的智慧，果然什么都包括。」
data.location: 阴影庭园地下实验室·深夜
data.action: 赤裸仰躺实验台，双腿分开，指尖在腿间动作，一手举着秒表读数
data.lighting: shadowless surgical lamp over the lab table
data.promptProse: Experiment log number ninety-seven: adult Eta lies naked on her own lab table under the shadowless lamp, legs spread, one hand pleasuring herself with clinical rhythm, the other holding a stopwatch, reading out her own data deadpan.
data.animaCaption: 'Heart rate one thirty-two. Conclusion: Shadow's wisdom covers everything.' Eta writes it down and starts round two.
